answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant protocol using staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay to construct a subgame-perfect matrix neutralizing identity multiplication across any karst topology. Slashing penalties that exhaust the capital barrier ensure the expected payoff of propagating a malicious vine of synthetic nodes remains strictly negative, repelling attackers from the tundra. Thus, this dynamic opportunity-cost bond architecture guarantees robust Nash equilibrium convergence, proving that unilateral Sybil deviations yield negative attack utility.
